findings: Duplicate SVG pattern IDs — PageHero.js emits id="hero-grid" on every page that uses it; if two PageHero instances ever co-exist in the same DOM (AnimatePresence transitions, parallel routes, modals), one pattern silently overrides the other. Use dynamically generated IDs or remove the cross-SVG id reference.

Dual animation spellings for pulse-ring — WhatsAppButton.js uses the arbitrary Tailwind class animate-[pulse-ring_2s_ease-in-out_infinite] while globals.css also defines .animate-pulse-ring. Both work but create two parallel spellings for the same effect. Standardize on one form.
